meta.title: UI Motion
meta.description: Adds a dithered signal-field backdrop to the new-session and chat pages, a blueprint headline on the new-session page, and frosted glass for the composer — every effect toggles independently under Settings → UI Motion.

runtime.title: UI motion
runtime.lead: Pick which pages show the effects, then tune the effects themselves. Changes apply instantly and are stored in this browser.
runtime.masterHint: When off, no canvas, no animation loop and no injected styles: the UI returns to the stock DSH look.
runtime.rowHeroPageHint: When off, the new session page returns to the stock DSH look (headline, backdrop and composer glass all stop).
runtime.rowChatPageHint: When off, the chat page returns to the stock DSH look, and the HUD panel glass turns off with it.
runtime.rowTitleIdleHint: Letter-by-letter reveal and sweep on entry; when off the headline is static.
runtime.rowTitleInteractHint: Glyphs turn into dashed outlines near the pointer and can be dragged; when off it ignores the pointer.
runtime.rowBackgroundIdleHint: The noise wave drifts on its own; when off the signal field is static.
runtime.rowBackgroundInteractHint: Cursor erase (light theme) / light-up (dark theme) and click ripples.
runtime.rowGlassHint: Frosted glass on the composer card and its backing; the blur radius is fixed at 14px.
runtime.rowIntensityHint: Only changes how dense the signal field is, not its speed; 30% by default.
runtime.reducedMotion: The system asks for reduced motion, so animation and pointer interaction are off by default; you can still switch them on here.
runtime.titleUnavailable: This DSH build exposes no headline mount point on the new session page, so headline effects are unavailable.
